name: Conjure Her
source:
As a young witch at Briar Patch Academy for Gifted Witches, you were fascinated and tormented by Professor Evangeline Ceto. Twenty years later, you conjure her from beyond the grave, seeking answers and an explanation. 

[From [url=https://branches.itch.io/conjureher]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
年轻时，你在Briar Patch Academy for Gifted Witches就读，既着迷于教授Evangeline Ceto，又饱受她的折磨。二十年后，你将她从死亡世界召唤回来，寻求答案与解释。

[来源：[url=https://branches.itch.io/conjureher]Itch.io[/url]]
